name: Claimed vs visible SKU
method: Compare user expectation with NVML, CUDA and available PCI attributes.
boundary: Match, mismatch or unresolved expectation.

name: Exact variant
method: Form factor, memory size, part/subsystem identifiers where exposed.
boundary: Do not apply PCIe expectations to SXM/NVL.

name: CUDA capability
method: Architecture, multiprocessor count, cache and supported attributes.
boundary: Attribute consistency, not a die-authenticity certificate.

name: Usable device
method: Initialize chosen device and execute checked work.
boundary: Management visibility differs from application access.

name: Memory allocation shape
method: Reported capacity, free bytes and successful bounded allocation.
boundary: Accessible capacity mismatch; physical type not proven.

name: MIG / vGPU mode
method: Supported partition queries and runtime-visible resource shape.
boundary: Slice or full-device expectation; unknown remains unknown.

name: Stable target mapping
method: Map UUID/PCI/runtime handle; recheck before each worker.
boundary: Stop if the selected resource changes or is ambiguous.

name: Visible count / uniqueness
method: Enumerate permitted devices without stressing peers.
boundary: Expected visibility mismatch; no hidden-host inventory claim.

name: Performance signature
method: Compute/memory/transfer pattern against same-method references.
boundary: Identity inconsistency hypothesis, not specific counterfeit ID.

name: VBIOS / OEM consistency
method: Exposed version against signed vendor/OEM references when available.
boundary: Unrecognized version is unknown, not automatically modified.

name: Virtualization context
method: Allowlisted cgroup, namespace, DMI/CPU signals where available.
boundary: Observed execution context; not isolation proof.

name: Hardware-rooted attestation
method: Supported device and CPU-TEE evidence with independent verifier.
boundary: Precisely scoped verified claims, not a health/performance pass.

name: ECC availability/state
method: Capability-aware ECC queries and error status.
boundary: Enabled, disabled, unsupported or blocked; never “zero” for N/A.

name: Corrected-error delta
method: Pre/post counters with reset/epoch detection.
boundary: New events during the scan; historical total kept separately.

name: Uncorrectable-error delta
method: Device-scoped events, counter deltas and recovery state.
boundary: Stop active testing when a current critical condition is detected.

name: Row-remap state
method: Pending, failure, available reserve and supported remap fields.
boundary: Maintenance required versus historical repaired condition.

name: Retired memory pages
method: Supported page-retirement state and pending action.
boundary: Contextual health signal; no universal lifetime threshold.

name: Xid evidence
method: NVML events and readable kernel logs, mapped to GPU/time.
boundary: Hardware/software/application possibilities remain distinct.

name: Sampled memory patterns
method: Known patterns in test-owned allocations; verified readback.
boundary: Exact bytes/patterns/passes tested and mismatch count.

name: Broader accessible-memory sweep
method: Bounded chunks, varied patterns and headroom protection.
boundary: Larger logical coverage; never all physical VRAM claimed.

name: Compute correctness
method: Known-answer operations; independent host checks where practical.
boundary: Reproducible wrong output is a blocker; investigate cause.

name: Errors across repeated load
method: Compare early/late error deltas and successful operations.
boundary: Observed stability interval, not multi-day survival probability.

name: Vendor diagnostics
method: Selected target-restricted DCGM tests within approved budget.
boundary: Retain individual pass/fail/skip results and plugin versions.

name: Context/device loss
method: Worker status, timeout, CUDA errors and device reappearance.
boundary: Distinguish test failure, software failure and device loss.

name: FP32 compute
method: Qualified GEMM shapes, timings and checked results.
boundary: Measured dense throughput vs eligible same-method reference.

name: BF16/FP16 tensor compute
method: Explicit operand/accumulator type and supported library path.
boundary: Relevant accelerator path, no sparse/dense confusion.

name: TF32 precision behavior
method: Explicit math mode and verification tolerance.
boundary: Avoid comparing TF32 and full-FP32 results as equivalent.

name: FP8/INT8 capability
method: Only qualified supported kernels and scale conventions.
boundary: Not tested rather than failed when the test path is absent.

name: Device-memory bandwidth
method: Large-buffer streaming or qualified copy test exceeding cache scale.
boundary: Effective bandwidth with exact read/write byte definition.

name: Cache / working-set sweep
method: Vary working set and strides within owned memory.
boundary: Separate cache effects from sustained device-memory behavior.

name: Pinned H2D / D2H
method: Separate transfer directions with checksum and host placement.
boundary: Transfer result, host-memory context and tested size.

name: Launch/dispatch latency
method: Repeated small operations with warm-up and explicit synchronization.
boundary: Jitter symptom; not proof of time-sharing.

name: Sustained compute curve
method: Non-overlapping early/late windows, clocks and event timeline.
boundary: Measured degradation over this interval only.

name: Repeatability
method: Robust spread, outliers and sample count across windows.
boundary: Unstable measurement or allocation; cause may be unresolved.

name: Real application proxy
method: Pinned inference/training/rendering test with representative inputs.
boundary: Proxy result explicitly separated from the user’s real job.

name: Timing/data validity
method: CUDA errors, returned result checks, wall/event time consistency.
boundary: Invalidate implausible or incomplete measurements.

name: Power configuration
method: Supported configured/default/allowed limits and declared profile.
boundary: Disclosed setting versus possible allocation mismatch.

name: Power/performance relationship
method: Align telemetry with measured work windows.
boundary: Quantify observed performance gap, not a universal cap penalty.

name: Clock-event reasons
method: Supported reason masks/counters and sampling intervals.
boundary: Power limiting, thermal slowing and idle are distinguished.

name: Core temperature
method: Available sensor and device-specific thresholds.
boundary: Operating observation; no generic one-temperature verdict.

name: Memory temperature
method: Read only if exposed; otherwise record missing.
boundary: Do not infer junction temperature from core temperature.

name: Cooling stability
method: Temperature/performance trend under bounded load.
boundary: Short-duration correlation, not thermal-paste or mining history.

name: Fan/chassis signals
method: Supported fan data; server cooling only with host access.
boundary: Passive GPU without fan metric is not a failed fan.

name: PCIe negotiated link
method: Width/generation at idle and during transfer; endpoint capabilities.
boundary: Persistent narrow/slow path versus idle power management.

name: PCIe error deltas
method: Supported replay counters and available AER evidence.
boundary: Rate/context of errors; no hardware cause from total alone.

name: NUMA-sensitive transfer
method: Repeat on permitted host placement when safe and meaningful.
boundary: Placement-sensitive bottleneck and verified retest direction.

name: GPU energy per work
method: Supported energy or integrated telemetry with scope labels.
boundary: GPU-only estimate, not whole-node electricity or billed spend.

name: Power/cooling root cause
method: Correlate BMC/PSU/inlet telemetry with GPU behavior.
boundary: Provider-side investigation, not guest-side PSU diagnosis.

name: Effective CPU allocation
method: Allowed CPUs, affinity, quota and cgroup hierarchy visibility.
boundary: Visible CPUs are not necessarily usable CPU entitlement.

name: CPU quota throttling
method: cpu.stat deltas where exposed.
boundary: Time lost to quota enforcement, not proof of host overselling.

name: Reported steal time
method: /proc/stat interval with virtualization context.
boundary: Hypervisor-reported unavailable CPU time; cause unproven.

name: CPU throughput
method: Short bounded sysbench/stress-ng or own test, run separately.
boundary: Only compare equivalent effective host allocations.

name: RAM limit/headroom
method: Process/cgroup limits, current usage and available host context.
boundary: Job-visible memory ceiling and current headroom.

name: OOM/reclaim events
method: cgroup memory.events and readable relevant logs.
boundary: Observed resource event; historical scope disclosed.

name: Swap and pressure
method: Available swap activity and PSI windows.
boundary: Resource-waiting symptoms affecting the job.

name: Shared-memory capacity
method: /dev/shm capacity/use and intended runtime needs.
boundary: Small capacity is a caveat, not guaranteed DataLoader failure.

name: Pinned-memory/process limits
method: Relevant ulimits, pids and resource restrictions.
boundary: Explain the specific operation a limit may block.

name: NUMA / affinity map
method: Available CPU/memory locality relative to selected GPU.
boundary: Placement context; do not assume cross-NUMA is always fatal.

name: Host-RAM health/performance
method: Owned-buffer tests; EDAC/RAS evidence only with authorization.
boundary: No guest test certifies all installed physical RAM.

name: Input-pipeline waiting
method: Profile data loading, CPU preparation and transfer under real job.
boundary: GPU waiting on host, with measured critical-path effect.

name: Free space and quota
method: Selected workspace filesystem, writable access and visible limits.
boundary: Capacity available to this job, not entire-host disk size.

name: Mount/persistence context
method: Exposed filesystem/mount data plus provider/user declaration.
boundary: Measured access separated from declared persistence.

name: Sequential read/write
method: Bounded fio scratch-file workload with cache method stated.
boundary: Measured path throughput, not NVMe/SATA hardware identity.

name: Random/small-file access
method: Representative I/O size, depth and file distribution.
boundary: Whether this dataset layout is a limiting factor.

name: Slow I/O operations
method: Latency distribution with enough samples and test conditions.
boundary: Tail measurements without overclaiming from tiny samples.

name: Cache and burst effects
method: Record warm/cold method, file size and sustained window.
boundary: Cached burst is not advertised as device steady-state speed.

name: Test-file integrity
method: Known test content and readback/checksum verification.
boundary: Only test-owned data verified; failure needs corroboration.

name: Checkpoint save/load
method: Application-defined save, read and resume validation.
boundary: Recovery actually works within the tested contract.

name: Checkpoint cost
method: Measured save/pause/upload time and retained capacity.
boundary: Progress-protection trade-off for the user’s job.

name: Storage health telemetry
method: smartctl/nvme-cli/BMC only with authorized host access.
boundary: Device-scoped wear/error signals; guest visibility may be absent.

name: Visible route/interface context
method: Read-only selected route/interface information.
boundary: Connectivity context without scanning neighbors.

name: Required endpoint reachability
method: User-authorized DNS/TLS/HTTP request with deadline.
boundary: This endpoint is reachable or failed for a named reason.

name: Real artifact pull
method: Fixed-revision, licensed public object or user-selected object; bounded bytes.
boundary: Measured endpoint transfer, including authentication/cache context.

name: Download duration estimate
method: Known object byte size divided by representative measured rate.
boundary: Assumption-labeled range; parameter count alone is insufficient.

name: Upload/checkpoint path
method: Authorized write to a designated test object and cleanup.
boundary: Actual destination throughput, not generic upload speed.

name: TCP throughput/latency
method: Controlled iperf3 peer, direction, streams and settings.
boundary: Peer- and path-specific result with repeatability.

name: Loss/retransmit evidence
method: Available transport counters; bounded UDP only with permission.
boundary: Transport symptom, not an automatic provider fault.

name: Serving reachability
method: Controlled client connecting to the user’s explicit test endpoint.
boundary: No arbitrary port scanning or assertion of universal reachability.

name: Location/IP context
method: Optional provider declaration and consensual external lookup.
boundary: Approximate network context; no physical-location or trust proof.

name: Network costs/limits
method: Declared tariffs, transferred bytes and explicit provider data.
boundary: Egress/transfer costs and potential limit context.

name: Inter-node fabric
method: Authorized RDMA/NCCL measurements between selected allocations.
boundary: No single-GPU test can establish cluster-fabric quality.

name: Driver/runtime versions
method: Loaded driver/runtime/library versions, not only smi heading.
boundary: Actual compatibility context; CUDA driver support differs from installed toolkit.

name: Library usability
method: Load required libraries; execute bounded initialization/smoke operation.
boundary: Missing dependency vs incompatible runtime vs GPU failure.

name: Probe compatibility
method: Worker architecture and pinned library/runtime requirements.
boundary: Unsupported worker is a test limitation, not a bad card.

name: Documented driver issue
method: Curated vendor advisory with exact range, SKU, symptom and date.
boundary: Applicable known issue; no broad “old driver = broken” rule.

name: Framework import/operation
method: Explicit PyTorch/other stack smoke test in selected environment.
boundary: One real supported operation, not an import-only pass.

name: Required extension
method: User-selected attention/render/quantization extension and test.
boundary: Feature works in the requested stack or remains unverified.

name: Container resource setup
method: Relevant shm, memlock, pids and device accessibility.
boundary: Specific configuration caveat without changing security controls.

name: Application numerical checks
method: Customer validation contract plus appropriate precision tolerances.
boundary: Outputs meet tested criteria; not a model-quality certificate.

name: Application sanitizer run
method: Optional Compute Sanitizer outside timed performance path.
boundary: Diagnose program errors, not certify physical VRAM.

name: Reproducible environment
method: Build IDs, test-pack digest and relevant image/library identifiers.
boundary: Result can be reproduced or its limitations are visible.

name: Time-to-useful-result
method: Installer/startup/model-load/first-success phases separately timed.
boundary: Instance-start timing requires trustworthy start-time evidence.

name: Dataset/license readiness
method: Verify requested model/data availability and user-authorized access.
boundary: No automatic gated-model pull or execution of untrusted model code.

name: Idle GPU consumption
method: Supported utilization/memory/process evidence in visible scope.
boundary: Unexplained consumption; reserve driver/framework memory considered.

name: Visible competing processes
method: Minimal process metadata for permitted scope; optional known indicators.
boundary: A process name is not proof of a miner or malware.

name: Dangerous container exposure
method: Observe capabilities, privileged indicators and mounted control sockets.
boundary: Report exposure and least-privilege advice; never exploit it.

name: Tool integrity signals
method: Verify our artifacts; compare system packages to authentic references if available.
boundary: Modified or unverified tool, not proof the entire host is clean.

name: Loader/tampering indicators
method: Relevant allowlisted loader settings; do not collect full environment.
boundary: Potential influence on the test; legitimate instrumentation may explain it.

name: Unexpected connections
method: Optional metadata-only snapshot within authorized process scope.
boundary: Investigate unexplained egress; no payload capture by default.

name: Prior-tenant residue
method: Explicit workspace-only metadata check with user permission.
boundary: Potential provisioning hygiene issue; do not open others’ files.

name: SSH key continuity
method: Controller-held known-host record and independent confirmation.
boundary: Changed key needs verification; rebuilds may legitimately change keys.

name: Data-exposure guidance
method: Observed isolation and attestation status plus trust assumptions.
boundary: No datacenter/community label is a security certification.

name: External attestation verification
method: Fresh challenge, issuer/signature/revocation checks and CPU/GPU scope.
boundary: Attested properties only; report verification gaps separately.

name: Observed stability interval
method: Successful checked operations, errors and elapsed time.
boundary: No failure observed for the actual tested duration.

name: Transient slow windows
method: Repeated same-method windows with robust spread.
boundary: Measured variability, not “confirmed noisy neighbor.”

name: Warm-up vs deterioration
method: Timeline separating initialization, settling and later changes.
boundary: Do not extrapolate heat-soak failure from a short temperature slope.

name: History visibility
method: Uptime/reset epoch and oldest accessible event timestamp.
boundary: Host uptime is not the rental’s reliability history.

name: Clock sanity
method: Wall/monotonic consistency; exposed synchronization status.
boundary: Correlation uncertainty; no intrusive time reconfiguration.

name: Interruption model
method: User/provider-declared spot or interruptible contract.
boundary: Operational preparedness, not a predicted eviction time.

name: Host/allocation history
method: Consent-based controller-linked observations with identity uncertainty.
boundary: History of this identifiable allocation, not guaranteed permanent machine ID.

name: Guardian drift
method: Low-overhead passive monitoring; approved idle-time active retests.
boundary: Observed new event or change relative to the accepted baseline.

name: Failure-risk model
method: Labeled longitudinal outcomes, censoring, calibration and false-alarm evaluation.
boundary: No probability or checkpoint countdown until validated.

name: Checkpoint advice
method: User recovery-point goal plus measured checkpoint cost; explicit assumptions.
boundary: Protect progress without inventing a failure hazard.

name: Reproducible workload contract
method: Model/revision, precision, batch, shapes, concurrency and software digest.
boundary: Exactly what the assessment covers.

name: Inference behavior
method: Cold load, warm prefill/decode and latency/throughput with cache controls.
boundary: Useful output rate under the stated latency requirement.

name: Fine-tuning/training step
method: Representative forward/backward/optimizer work and token count.
boundary: Step speed and memory peak for this exact configuration.

name: Image generation
method: Fixed model, resolution, scheduler/steps and execution settings.
boundary: Images per time for tested settings; not quality ranking.

name: Rendering
method: Fixed scene/renderer/backend and correctness contract.
boundary: Rendering fit without assuming a data-center GPU supports every graphics feature.

name: Operating-range sweep
method: Bounded batches/context/concurrency and successful result checks.
boundary: Tested safe range; outside it remains unverified.

name: Critical-path profile
method: Compute, data-loader, transfer, storage and communication timelines.
boundary: The part actually delaying completed useful work.

name: Within-node imbalance
method: Compare same-stage devices/ranks with equal work and topology context.
boundary: Potential limiting device/path; unequal work is a confounder.

name: Cross-node stragglers
method: Rank-aware synchronized traces and comparable per-rank work.
boundary: Victim waiting at a collective is not automatically the cause.

name: Retry/resume rehearsal
method: Known failure boundary in an authorized test job and application resume.
boundary: Recovery behavior is measured, not inferred from a saved file.

name: Projection validity
method: Only interpolate calibrated tested configurations; show uncertainty.
boundary: No 13B/70B throughput estimate from generic GEMM alone.

name: Resource graph
method: Cluster/node/device/partition/NIC/storage-path relationships.
boundary: Scope of every observation remains explicit.

name: GPU pair paths
method: P2P access, measured bandwidth/latency and errors.
boundary: One weak pair distinguished from the node average.

name: NVLink/NVSwitch
method: Supported link/fabric state, counters and real transfers.
boundary: Exposed topology plus measured behavior.

name: Collectives
method: Correctness and performance by operation, size, ranks and transport.
boundary: Do not mix algorithm bandwidth with bus bandwidth.

name: Fabric transport
method: Actual NCCL/RDMA path, NIC affinity and supported GPUDirect tests.
boundary: Fallback transport vs intended high-performance path.

name: NIC/switch health
method: Authorized endpoint and operator-side error/congestion telemetry.
boundary: Guest symptoms distinguished from fabric root cause.

name: Clock/trace alignment
method: Measured clock uncertainty and monotonic local timing.
boundary: Trustworthy stage/rank correlation without false causal order.

name: Controlled scale ladder
method: Test available scales and jobs before extrapolating.
boundary: Eight GPUs tested does not certify a thousand-GPU cluster.

name: Scheduler readiness
method: Slurm/Kubernetes lifecycle and optional GCM/GPUd integration.
boundary: Do not run diagnostics concurrently with unapproved tenant work.

name: BMC/PSU/cooling
method: Read-only operator-authorized management-plane sensors.
boundary: Rack/environment limitations considered separately from GPU defects.

name: Cluster/storage services
method: Authorized throughput, checkpoints, metadata services and recovery tests.
boundary: Bottlenecks and fault domains across the actual workflow.

name: Controlled maintenance actions
method: Drain/cordon/ticket actions behind explicit approvals and rollback plans.
boundary: No autonomous cross-cluster resets or destructive repair.

name: Declared rental price
method: Optional user input with currency and billing unit.
boundary: Price supplied by user, not independently validated.

name: Reference-equivalent price
method: Price divided by eligible same-workload performance ratio.
boundary: Label equivalence scope; hide when reference is missing.

name: Cost per useful unit
method: Successful output plus latency/error constraints and relevant charges.
boundary: $/million tokens, image or step under tested conditions.

name: Scan cost
method: Measured runtime plus declared price; bytes and storage stated.
boundary: Software is free; testing still uses paid rental resources.

name: Hidden charges
method: Documented storage, egress, minimum increments and stop-state costs.
boundary: Declared vs observed charges remain separate.

name: Live alternatives
method: Timestamped authorized feeds with comparable availability/configuration.
boundary: Same SKU name alone is not a fair market comparison.

name: Keep/fix/switch decision
method: Expected work remaining, retest/downtime/data-transfer costs.
boundary: Performance improvement must exceed switching cost.

name: Evidence-backed ticket
method: Facts, reproduction, relevant reference and requested action.
boundary: Ask for investigation/replacement; do not allege fraud from a score.

name: Outcome verification
method: Post-fix/replacement retest with controlled configuration.
boundary: Did the proposed action actually improve useful work?

name: Fairness/audit
method: Reference and rule versions, provider conflict disclosures.
boundary: Payment never changes health gates or reference admission.

name: Return-policy applicability
method: Current official policy, purchase type and source date.
boundary: No guaranteed refund or universal dispute countdown.
